thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PAGER fired for service=metrics-ingest | alert=prometheus_scrape_failures | severity=critical | trigger=target_down_count>120 | link=https://pd.redwood/p/metrics-ingest/alerts/12345
ali_oncall: acked — I'm oncall, starting triage. tagging folks.
jamie_sre: I'm on signal. looking at prometheus -> lot of 503s/timeouts to exporters across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/metrics/targets?orgId=1
kim_ops: seeing big fanout from exporter rollout 10:22Z — new collector rolled to all nodes, lots of scrape endpoints returning 500s. also kafka consumer lag for logs-ingest rising (consumer_group=log-ingest, lag=~85k)
ali_oncall: timeline: pager fired at 10:31. first 2 pages auto-acked then escalated. how bad is customer impact?
ryan_platform: dashboards: alerting is impacted (missing scrape samples), dashboards show last sample ~+8m for many targets. log ingestion is queued but not failing writes to S3 yet.
jamie_sre: running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=metrics-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/metrics-proxy --since=15m | tail -n 100
```
metrics-proxy logs show repeated 504s to exporter pods and connection reset by peer.
kim_ops: stacktrace snippet from exporter:
```
2026-03-15T10:26:14Z ERROR exporter: handler panic: runtime: out of memory
```
looks like memory spike after new feature release (label cardinality bloom).
ali_oncall: ok plan: 1) throttle scrapes ASAP (increase scrape_interval) 2) scale metrics-proxy to drain backlog 3) revert offending deploy if quick rollback available 4) notify customers/support. I'll implement 1 & 2 now.
jamie_sre: adding temporary relabel to drop the new high-cardinality metric:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__name__]
    regex: "^app_.*_trace_id$"
    action: drop
```
applying to prometheus scrape config now (will push via config map).
ryan_platform: scaling metrics-proxy from 3 -> 12 replicas. command: `kubectl scale deploy/metrics-proxy --replicas=12 -n monitoring`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation — incident unacknowledged > 10m. Notifying on-call manager @lina_pm and team.
lina_pm: I'm up, thanks. what customer-facing message do we need?
support_ops: customers: we have a handful of dashboards reporting stale metrics and delayed alert firing. no ingestion data loss reported so far. suggested message: "We're investigating an internal metrics collection issue causing delays in dashboard updates. No data loss; working on mitigation." Want me to send?
ali_oncall: yes please send that to customers now (support-post). add note that we're throttling scrapes and will follow up with ETA for full recovery.
kim_ops: temporary mitigation applied: scrape_interval bumped to 60s for the problematic job and relabel config applied to drop high-card metrics. metrics-proxy scaled. exporting pods are still OOMing — redeploy rollback candidate identified (revision 2026-03-15T10:16).
jamie_sre: rolling back exporter to previous revision now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/exporter -n telemetry --to-revision=3`
ryan_platform: rollback initiated, watching pods recreate. kafka lag spike peaked at ~92k, now trending down to 40k after scaling back pressure and metrics-proxy absorbing load.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER acknowledged by ali_oncall at 10:39 (automated).
ali_oncall: ack + triage update: reverted exporter, relabels and throttle in place, scaling done. Monitoring shows target up count rising from 30 -> 180 in the last 3 minutes.
jamie_sre: verified prometheus scrape success: targets healthy. running a quick validate query on prometheus: `up{job=\"exporter\"}` shows >95% up.
kim_ops: kafka lag backfill scheduled — consumer group will backfill over next 2h, no data lost, only delayed.
lina_pm: good — support message sent, customers queued will get a follow-up once backfill completes. please create postmortem and update runbook with: "fail-fast rollback for exporter deploys; temporary scrape throttle knobs; PD escalation window adjustment"
ryan_platform: created incident ticket INC-2026-452 and postmortem stub: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-452
ali_oncall: next actions: double-check autoscaler settings to avoid OOM during rolling deploys, add alert for high-cardinality injection (threshold: sudden metric count delta > 25% in 5m), and update deploy playbook.
jamie_sre: will follow up with PR for relabeling and runbook notes. thanks everyone — marking this thread as resolved once backfill <5k lag.
support_ops: we'll keep customers informed and close the loop after postmortem. :thumbsup: 
ali_oncall: resolving pager for now — will reopen if lag/backfill doesn't finish. final status: mitigations applied, exporter rollback complete, targets recovering, customer impact: dashboards delayed ~10-20m for some tenants, no data loss. postmortem ticket filed.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PAGER resolved at 10:54 by ali_oncall
jamie_sre: quick retrospective note: don't gate pager delivery during deploys; rather, have a short deploy-suppress window plus a sanity check that ensures scrape success before full rollout. adding to runbook.
ali_oncall: thanks all — handoff complete.
ryan_platform: locking down follow-ups in INC-2026-452, assigning to jamie_sre and kim_ops.
kim_ops: will add memory limits and staging smoke tests for metrics exporter tomorrow.
